Sam (Design): uploaded a tiny iteration for vector inspector + export microcopy: https://www.figma.com/file/abc Main asks: add a compact badge, clarify download modal copy, and make preview keyboard flow explicit. Nora (PM): quick scan looks promising. prefer 'Download selected vectors' over generic Export. also the compact badge should show total rows and selected count. Ibrahim (Eng): technical note: rendering full vector previews for 200 rows will tank the DOM. propose lazy mount + placeholder skeletons. we'll also memoize the per-row preview render. Priya (A11y): flagged a11y bits: badge has low color contrast, tooltip not accessible via keyboard, and modal heading isn't announced when opened. recommend role="dialog" and focus trap + initial focus on the modal title. Kai (Product): +1 to explicit counts. we should show "Showing 1-25 of 10,432" style in the badge when filters applied. for small sets just show exact counts. design-bot: color contrast check: badge foreground #7A5AFF on bg #F8F9FB fails AA small. Suggest #5A3BD6 or using bold to meet thresholds. Sam (Design): updating badge color and changing copy to 'Download selected vectors (CSV)'. also adding helper line: 'Only visible columns will be included. Filters apply.' Ibrahim (Eng): for keyboard flow: when user expands row preview, focus move to preview container. ESC should collapse and restore focus to row toggle. Also ensure arrow key nav between previews is supported. Priya (A11y): sample ARIA for preview toggle: ```
``` Add live region: `aria-live="polite"` for async loading status. Nora (PM): timeline: need final copy + colors by Tues so Eng can slot into sprint. Sam (Design): will push final Figma by Mon EOD. leaving a couple mocks for the 10k+ shorthand state. thanks all :raised_hands: Priya (A11y): I'll do a quick screen reader pass after the Figma update and post accessibility checklist here. Ibrahim (Eng): sounds good. will prep implementation notes for lazy mounting and selection count debounce. Sam (Design): closing when Figma is updated.
